levels.name: Kyouka Fuushi
levels.description: Shunsuiken DMG is increased by 40% against opponents with 50% HP or less.

levels.name: World Source
levels.description: Namisen's maximum stack count is increased to 5. When Kamisato Ayato has at least 3 Namisen stacks, his Max HP is increased by 50%.

levels.name: To Admire the Flowers
levels.description: Increases the Level of Kamisato Art: Kyouka by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

levels.name: Endless Flow
levels.description: After using Kamisato Art: Suiyuu, all nearby party members will have 15% increased Normal Attack SPD for 15s.

levels.name: Bansui Ichiro
levels.description: Increases the Level of Kamisato Art: Suiyuu by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15

levels.name: Boundless Origin
levels.description: After using Kamisato Art: Kyouka, Ayato's next Shunsuiken attack will create 2 extra Shunsuiken strikes when they hit opponents, each one dealing 450% of Ayato's ATK as DMG. Both these Shunsuiken attacks will not be affected by Namisen.
